encoding_law: all 7! bijections from group elements to labels 0..6
program: if label(G)<label(Q), append G+Q; else append G-Q
labels: all 7^6 proposed complete label tuples, including unreachable tuples
actual_fiber: number of bijections whose actual adaptive run has the proposed labels
symbolic_fiber: number of bijections giving those labels to the affine forms reconstructed from the proposed labels
falsifier: any scalar-label tuple with unequal actual and symbolic encoding counts
claim_boundary: exhaustive finite control of both transcript-fiber directions for this fixed adaptive program
